text.description_html:
Don-Jo LSP-1, Latch Face Plate Conversion Plate

The Latch Spacer Plate is most often used to convert a 1-1/8 inch pre-drilled latch hole to fit a latch with a 1 inch face plate. This is especially helpful in situations when you have a door drilled for a commercial lever but want to use a residential lever instead.

Features and Specifications of the 1" Latch Space Plate for 1-1/8" Door Preparations:

  • Length: 2-3/16"
  • Width: 1-3/32"
  • Mounting Hole Center to Center: 1-9/16"
  • Material: Black Plastic
